title: MIMI room <-> IRC channel bridge (meshIRCd, tailircd, any IRC network)
description: Mark 2026-11-21. The agent connects OUT to an IRC network (Mark's meshIRCd and tailircd first: github.com/MarkAtwood/meshIRCd, /tailircd; notes in docs/irc-lessons.md) as an IRC client and relays between a MIMI room and an IRC channel. Relay mode as in docs/design/marmot-bridge.md (one bridge identity per side, '(via bridge)', mimid-on-behalf-of, consent, loop prevention, hold/retract not needed), reusing its relay-mode design and the multi-user host later for puppets. E2EE ends at the bridge (IRC is not E2EE). meshIRCd bead ircd-atjq already names mimid-agent's local IRC interface as the E2EE route. Design note first (docs/design/irc-bridge.md), code after Mark's review.
